::: {.site-highlight}
These resources are useful after the summer school for building practical
skills, revisiting core concepts, and finding opportunities for further study.
Start with the section closest to your current interests, then follow the
links at your own pace.
:::

## Bioinformatics and computational biology

### Bioconductor

The [Bioconductor training and education
resources](https://training.bioconductor.org/) include courses and teaching
materials for bioinformatics in R. You may also find these useful:

- [Bioconductor books](https://bioconductor.org/help/bioconductor-books/)
- [Previous workshops and recorded materials](https://bioconductor.org/help/)

### Practice problems

- [Rosalind](https://rosalind.info/problems/list-view/) - programming and
  algorithms problems designed around biology.
- [Software Carpentry lessons](https://software-carpentry.org/lessons/) -
  lessons on Git, version control, Python, the Unix shell, and related tools.

## Image analysis

- [Microscopy image analysis course](https://github.com/wisstock/BioInUA_2025_img_analysis)
  - course materials from BioInUA 2025.

## Data science and machine learning

### Practice and online courses

- [Kaggle competitions](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions) - open data
  science problems and competitions.
- [Linux Foundation training portal](https://trainingportal.linuxfoundation.org/learn/dashboard)
  - courses covering Git, the Bash shell, and general IT topics.
- [Git Mastery playground](https://gitmastery.me/intro/?stage=Intro&level=1)
  - an interactive introduction to Git.
- [Hugging Face courses](https://huggingface.co/learn) - courses on modern AI
  and machine-learning models; some may be free for students in Ukraine.

### Books

- **Introduction to Data Science** - R. Irizarry (Chapman & Hall/CRC, 2024,
  ISBN: 9781032116556). Covers summary statistics, probability, statistical
  inference, linear models, high-dimensional data, and machine learning with
  applied case studies.
- **An Introduction to Statistical Learning** - G. James, D. Witten,
  T. Hastie, and R. Tibshirani (Springer, 2013,
  ISBN: 978-0-387-84858-7). Introduces regression, classification, resampling,
  and unsupervised learning through practical examples.
- **Modern Statistics for Modern Biology** - S. Holmes and W. Huber
  (Cambridge University Press, 2019, ISBN: 9781108705295). Introduces
  statistical thinking and computational methods for modern biological data.
- **Deep Learning with Python** - F. Chollet (Manning Publications, 2021,
  ISBN: 9781617296864). Provides a practical introduction to deep learning,
  including modern architectures such as transformers and diffusion models.

### Additional videos and tutorials

- [Video introduction to large language models](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkrNMKz9pWU)
- [Great Youtube channel on statistics and ML](https://www.youtube.com/@statquest)


## Internships and funding

For students looking for funded research internships abroad, the
[Molecular Biology School summer internship
program](https://molbioschool.org/en/school/news/summer-internships/) offers
funding for life-science research internships worldwide for up to three months
in a laboratory of the student's choice.
